verses.en: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,
verses.zh: 大流士王第二年六月初一日，耶和华的话藉先知哈该向犹大省长撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚说：

the + a prophet or  inspired man
Jehudah , the name of five Israelites

verses.en: “This is what the LORD of Armies says: These people say, ‘The time hasn’t yet come, the time for the LORD’s house to be built.’”
verses.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：「这百姓说，建造耶和华殿的时候尚未来到。」

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: Then the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
verses.zh: 那时耶和华的话临到先知哈该说：

words.g: the + a prophet or  inspired man

verses.en: “Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses, while this house lies waste?
verses.zh: 「这殿仍然荒凉，你们自己还住天花板的房屋吗？

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Now therefore this is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.
verses.zh: 现在万军之耶和华如此说：你们要省察自己的行为。

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: You have sown much, and bring in little. You eat, but you don’t have enough. You drink, but you aren’t filled with drink. You clothe yourselves, but no one is warm; and he who earns wages earns wages to put them into a bag with holes in it.’
verses.zh: 你们撒的种多，收的却少；你们吃，却不得饱；喝，却不得足；穿衣服，却不得暖；得工钱的，将工钱装在破漏的囊中。」

verses.en: “This is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.
verses.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：「你们要省察自己的行为。

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: Go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house. I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified,” says the LORD.
verses.zh: 你们要上山取木料，建造这殿，我就因此喜乐，且得荣耀。这是耶和华说的。

verses.en: “You looked for much, and, behold, it came to little; and when you brought it home, I blew it away. Why?” says the LORD of Armies, “Because of my house that lies waste, while each of you is busy with his own house.
verses.zh: 你们盼望多得，所得的却少；你们收到家中，我就吹去。这是为甚么呢？因为我的殿荒凉，你们各人却顾（原文是奔）自己的房屋。这是万军之耶和华说的。

words.g: and + to puff, in various applications
a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar
and + thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Therefore for your sake the heavens withhold the dew, and the earth withholds its fruit.
verses.zh: 所以为你们的缘故，天就不降甘露，地也不出土产。

words.g: to restrict, by act  or word
to restrict, by act  or word
produce, i.e. a crop or  wealth + +her/its

verses.en: I called for a drought on the land, on the mountains, on the grain, on the new wine, on the oil, on that which the ground produces, on men, on livestock, and on all the labor of the hands.”
verses.zh: 我命干旱临到地土、山冈、五谷、新酒，和油，并地上的出产、人民、牲畜，以及人手一切劳碌得来的。」

verses.en: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the LORD their God’s voice, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the LORD their God had sent him; and the people feared the LORD.
verses.zh: 那时，撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚，并剩下的百姓，都听从耶和华―他们神的话和先知哈该奉耶和华―他们神差来所说的话；百姓也在耶和华面前存敬畏的心。

words.g: the + a prophet or  inspired man

verses.en: Then Haggai, the LORD’s messenger, spoke the LORD’s message to the people, saying, “I am with you,” says the LORD.
verses.zh: 耶和华的使者哈该奉耶和华差遣对百姓说：「耶和华说：我与你们同在。」

verses.en: The LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and worked on the house of the LORD of Armies, their God,
verses.zh: 耶和华激动犹大省长撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚，并剩下之百姓的心，他们就来为万军之耶和华―他们神的殿做工。

verses.zh: 这是在大流士王第二年六月二十四日。

words.g: the + a prophet or  inspired man

verses.zh: 「你要晓谕犹大省长撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚，并剩下的百姓，说：

words.g: Jehudah , the name of five Israelites

verses.en: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How do you see it now? Isn’t it in your eyes as nothing?
verses.zh: 你们中间存留的，有谁见过这殿从前的荣耀呢？现在你们看着如何？岂不在眼中看如无有吗？」

verses.en: Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says the LORD. ‘Be strong, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ says the LORD, ‘and work, for I am with you,’ says the LORD of Armies.
verses.zh: 耶和华说：「所罗巴伯啊，虽然如此，你当刚强！约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚啊，你也当刚强！这地的百姓，你们都当刚强做工，因为我与你们同在。这是万军之耶和华说的。

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: This is the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, and my Spirit lived among you. ‘Don’t be afraid.’
verses.zh: 这是照着你们出埃及我与你们立约的话。那时，我的灵住在你们中间，你们不要惧怕。」

words.g: from + Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt

verses.en: For this is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Yet once more, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the dry land;
verses.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：「过不多时，我必再一次震动天地、沧海，与旱地。

verses.en: and I will shake all nations. The treasure of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says the LORD of Armies.
verses.zh: 我必震动万国；万国的珍宝必都运来（或译：万国所羡慕的必来到），我就使这殿满了荣耀。这是万军之耶和华说的。」

words.g: and + to undulate , particularly through fear
weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says the LORD of Armies; ‘and in this place I will give peace,’ says the LORD of Armies.”
verses.zh: 这殿后来的荣耀必大过先前的荣耀；在这地方我必赐平安。这是万军之耶和华说的。」

words.g: to + Darejavesh, a title  of several Persian kings
the + a prophet or  inspired man

verses.en: “The LORD of Armies says: Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,
verses.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：「你要向祭司问律法，

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: ‘If someone carries holy meat in the fold of his garment, and with his fold touches bread, stew, wine, oil, or any food, will it become holy?’” The priests answered, “No.”
verses.zh: 说：若有人用衣襟兜圣肉，这衣襟挨着饼，或汤，或酒，或油，或别的食物，便算为圣吗？」祭司说：「不算为圣。」

verses.en: Then Haggai said, “If one who is unclean by reason of a dead body touches any of these, will it be unclean?” The priests answered, “It will be unclean.”
verses.zh: 哈该又说：「若有人因摸死尸染了污秽，然后挨着这些物的哪一样，这物算污秽吗？」祭司说：「必算污秽。」

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Then Haggai answered, “‘So is this people, and so is this nation before me,’ says the LORD; ‘and so is every work of their hands. That which they offer there is unclean.
verses.zh: 于是哈该说：「耶和华说：这民这国，在我面前也是如此；他们手下的各样工作都是如此；他们在坛上所献的也是如此。」

verses.en: Now, please consider from this day and backward, before a stone was laid on a stone in the LORD’s temple.
verses.zh: 现在你们要追想，此日以前，耶和华的殿没有一块石头垒在石头上的光景。

verses.zh: 在那一切日子，有人来到谷堆，想得二十斗，只得了十斗。有人来到酒池，想得五十桶，只得了二十桶。

verses.zh: 我必倾覆列国的宝座，除灭列邦的势力，并倾覆战车和坐在其上的。马必跌倒，骑马的败落，各人被弟兄的刀所杀。

verses.zh: 万军之耶和华说：我仆人撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯啊，到那日，我必以你为印，因我拣选了你。这是万军之耶和华说的。」
